domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report supply split was retrievable: web_search returned no results (searx connection refused) and volza.com, eximpedia.app and trademo.com all returned HTTP 403 Forbidden on the free views. The only public trace is the company's own import activity for vessel spare parts (Volvo Penta engines, Mercury Marine parts, marine electronics), which indicates an operating boatbuilding/refit business but is not a domestic supply record.
note: Declared HS 890690 (vessels) is not contradicted by anything found, but it is also not corroborated by any shipment record: the customs data that does exist for this entity is entirely inbound procurement of marine components (HS 74152900, 84871000, 39269069, 84081093), not outbound vessel deliveries. Per Rule 5, no export shipment with date, destination, HS code and B/L number was located, and no domestic supply evidence (GST turnover, GeM/CPPP contract, annual-report split) was retrievable — so the honest statement is: следов экспортных отгрузок не найдено, внутренние поставки не подтверждены. This is a data-availability limitation, not proof the company does not deliver vessels; the free tiers of the four shipment databases were either blocked (403) or showed import-only records. Revenue and export volume: null — not public in any source reached, not estimated. No CIN/PAN asserted. Recommend a paid Volza/Eximpedia export-side query and a GST-portal turnover check before any final verdict.
